_metadata.description: Switch the preview iframe's theme between built-in themes and themes derived from a target scenario's DESIGN.md.

requirements.title: Built-in themes are seeded into the registry and selectable from the UI
requirements.description: `builtin_themes` (id, name, tokens_json) is seeded at boot with: vrooli-default, neutral-light, neutral-dark, high-contrast. `ThemesService.ListBuiltinThemes` lists them; `GetBuiltinTheme` returns tokens. Seed is idempotent (skipped when table non-empty).

validation.notes: internal/themes/service_test.go::TestEnsureBuiltinsSeeded_PopulatesWhenEmpty + NoopWhenNonEmpty + GetBuiltin_NotFound. sqlite_test.go covers Upsert/Replace/List/Count round-trips against a real SQLite handle. UI selector remains follow-up work (TH-003 below).

requirements.title: Target scenario's DESIGN.md is resolved server-side to normalized JSON
requirements.description: `ThemesService.GetThemeFromScenario` (Connect-RPC) reads the named scenario's `DESIGN.md` via the storage resolver (path-traversal-guarded under the adoptions scenarios root), parses the YAML front-matter using the canonical `vrooli-default` schema (colors, typography, rounded, spacing), and returns a flat CSS-custom-property token map (e.g. `--color-primary`, `--rounded-sm`, `--typography-body-md-fontfamily`). Malformed front-matter → ErrInvalidDesignMD (Connect InvalidArgument). The client never builds the URL or parses DESIGN.md directly.

validation.notes: internal/themes/design_md_test.go covers ExtractFrontMatter (happy + missing + unclosed) and ParseDesignMDToTheme (flow-verifier fixture, empty-shape rejection, bad-YAML rejection). service_test.go::TestResolveFromScenario_OK + Missing pin the wiring.

requirements.title: Preview harness mounts the selected theme as CSS custom properties before render
requirements.description: When a theme is selected, the host posts the normalized tokens via the bridge. The harness child applies them as CSS custom properties on `:root` before mounting the component, then triggers a re-render.

validation.notes: BAS flow `theme-switch-applies` confirms the preview reflects the theme change.
